invariants.rationale: The method immediately uses 'operationType' for an equals check, so it must be non-null.
'instantTime' is passed directly into methods and compared, so null would cause an exception.
'table' is dereferenced and its methods are called, so it must be non-null.
'pendingCompactionTimeline' is used to check for containsInstant, indicating it must not be null.
The method throws an exception if the operationType is LOG_COMPACT, so at method entry this cannot be true for normal execution.
